method: Input per call counted with the free token counting endpoint; uncached input is that count less the billed 57,494 token cached prefix. Output per call from measured 0003.x runs of the same unit kind, named per unit. Central: the mean of the kind's 0003.1 runs; wider: the highest single call across both measured points of the kind. Kinds with no 0003.x measurement: central is the mean of the six 0003.1 section calls, wider is the heaviest measured 0003.x call. Each unit is priced at 3 runs plus 1 retry, each retry a full call at the same figure. One 1 hour cache write (the first call); every other call reads it.
